_about: The vocabulary of a professional services firm's client engagements: many clients, every fact traced to the right client and engagement. Derived from the questions in questions.json.
name: client-engagement

Client.label: client
Client.definition: An organization the firm sells to or works for.

Engagement.label: engagement
Engagement.definition: One piece of work for one client, from the first conversation about it through to its close, whether or not it was ever signed.
Engagement.scope_note: It starts at the first conversation, so sales meetings before a signature have somewhere to belong. Follow-on work is a new engagement linked to the one it came from.

Person.label: person
Person.definition: A named individual on the client's side or the firm's.
Person.scope_note: A person stands on their own because one person can work on many engagements.

Role.label: role
Role.definition: A seat on one engagement: what someone is there to do, on which side, filled by a named person or still unfilled.
Role.scope_note: A role with no person is valid: documents often name the seat before the person is known.

Interaction.label: interaction
Interaction.definition: Something that took place with or about a client on a date: a meeting, presentation, call, workshop, interview or a document sent by email.
Interaction.scope_note: This is the event. Its notes or transcript are a source document, a different thing with a different date.

DiscussionPoint.label: discussion point
DiscussionPoint.definition: One thing said during an interaction, and who raised it.

Topic.label: topic
Topic.definition: A subject that can come up across interactions.
Topic.scope_note: A topic stands on its own because the same subject recurs across meetings; it is reached for a client through what was said at that client's interactions.

EngagementDocument.label: engagement document
EngagementDocument.definition: A named, versioned document the firm produces or exchanges on an engagement: a proposal, statement of work, agreement, deck or report.
EngagementDocument.scope_note: This is the business object, with its version and whether the client may see it. The source file a fact cites is a separate Document.

ScopeItem.label: scope item
ScopeItem.definition: One thing explicitly in or out of an engagement's scope.

Deliverable.label: deliverable
Deliverable.definition: Something the firm owes the client on an engagement.

SuccessCriterion.label: success criterion
SuccessCriterion.definition: A test by which an engagement or one deliverable will be judged.
SuccessCriterion.scope_note: It may judge a deliverable or the whole engagement. Subjective criteria are worth marking, because they are where acceptance disputes begin.

Commitment.label: commitment
Commitment.definition: Something the firm promised or implied, in an interaction or a document.
Commitment.scope_note: Its purpose is to expose promises the statement of work does not cover or contradicts.

Assumption.label: assumption
Assumption.definition: Something the plan or the price rests on that may turn out false.

Milestone.label: milestone
Milestone.definition: A dated gate, checkpoint or readout on an engagement.
Milestone.scope_note: A gate's conditions are open items and decisions that block it.

Price.label: price
Price.definition: The commercial terms of an engagement at a point in time: fee, model, margin and contingency.
Price.scope_note: Margin and contingency are internal. Marking them does not restrict who can read the graph.

Decision.label: decision
Decision.definition: A choice waiting to be made or already made on an engagement, with who decides, why and what else was considered.

Risk.label: risk
Risk.definition: Something that may harm an engagement, with its rating, mitigation and owner.
Risk.scope_note: A risk that happens can point to the open item it became.

Finding.label: finding
Finding.definition: Something the firm concluded about the client's situation, on evidence.
Finding.scope_note: The graph stops at what the firm found, not the client's whole organization or program.

Recommendation.label: recommendation
Recommendation.definition: What the firm advised the client to do, and how the client responded.

OpenItem.label: open item
OpenItem.definition: Something still to be done or resolved: an action, something needed from the client, or an issue.
OpenItem.scope_note: What the firm needs from the client is an open item owned on the client's side.

ChangeRequest.label: change request
ChangeRequest.definition: A request to change an engagement's scope, price or dates, with what triggered it and its outcome.

ReusableAsset.label: reusable asset
ReusableAsset.definition: A method, template, rubric or tool of the firm's that can be used on many engagements.
ReusableAsset.scope_note: It belongs to the firm, not to any client.

for_client.definition: The client this engagement is for. Exactly one.
for_client.label: for client

on_engagement.definition: The one engagement this belongs to.
on_engagement.label: on engagement

follows_on_from.definition: The engagement this follow-on work came out of.
follows_on_from.label: follows on from

filled_by.definition: The person currently holding this seat.
filled_by.label: filled by

concerns_engagement.definition: The engagement this interaction or source document concerns. An interaction may concern several.
concerns_engagement.label: concerns engagement

with_client.definition: The client this interaction was with. Stated for a general relationship meeting, and derived when the interaction concerns an engagement.
with_client.label: with client

attended_by.definition: Someone present at, or receiving, this interaction.
attended_by.label: attended by

presented.definition: A document, finding or recommendation shown or sent in this interaction.
presented.label: presented

recorded_in.definition: The source document holding this interaction's notes or transcript.
recorded_in.label: recorded in

said_in.definition: The interaction where this was said. Exactly one.
said_in.label: said in

about_topic.definition: The subject this statement is about.
about_topic.label: about topic

raised_in.definition: The interaction this open item came out of.
raised_in.label: raised in

defined_in.definition: The document and version that states this.
defined_in.label: defined in

judges.definition: The deliverable this criterion judges. Absent when it judges the whole engagement.
judges.label: judges

covered_by.definition: The scope item or deliverable that covers this promise.
covered_by.label: covered by

contradicted_by.definition: A scope item that contradicts this promise, such as an exclusion.
contradicted_by.label: contradicted by

decided_by.definition: Who must make this decision, or who made it.
decided_by.label: decided by

taken_in.definition: The interaction where this decision was taken.
taken_in.label: taken in

blocks.definition: What cannot move until this is settled.
blocks.label: blocks

became.definition: The open item this risk turned into when it happened.
became.label: became

addresses.definition: The finding this recommendation responds to.
addresses.label: addresses

uses_asset.definition: A firm asset used on this engagement.
uses_asset.label: uses asset

sector.definition: The client's industry, as the firm describes it.

stage.definition: Where this work is, from the first conversation to its close or loss.

service_line.definition: The kind of work, used to find similar past work.
service_line.label: service line

client_ask.definition: What the client asked for, in their terms.
client_ask.label: client ask

success_measured_by.definition: How the client measures success today, which may differ from how this work will be judged.
success_measured_by.label: success measured by

organization.definition: The organization this person works for, as named.

role_kind.definition: What this seat is there to do.
role_kind.label: role kind

time_commitment.definition: How much of this person's time the seat takes, as the document says it.
time_commitment.label: time commitment

interaction_kind.definition: What sort of interaction this was.
interaction_kind.label: interaction kind

document_kind.definition: What sort of document this is.
document_kind.label: document kind

version.definition: The version as the firm names it.

audience.definition: Whether this version stays inside the firm or has been shared with the client.

scope_state.definition: Whether this is in or out of scope.
scope_state.label: in or out

reason.definition: Why it is in or out, or why it moved.

checkable.definition: Whether two people would agree on whether it was met.

change_trigger.definition: What would make this a change request if it proved false.
change_trigger.label: change trigger

milestone_kind.definition: What sort of milestone this is.
milestone_kind.label: milestone kind

margin.definition: The margin as a percentage. Internal.

contingency.definition: The contingency as a percentage. Internal.

billable_days.definition: The billable days this price assumes.
billable_days.label: billable days

decision_state.definition: Whether this decision is waiting or made.
decision_state.label: decision state

reason.definition: Why it was decided this way.

options_considered.definition: The options that were on the table, including those rejected.
options_considered.label: options considered

likelihood.definition: How likely it is, as last rated. Some documents name a risk without rating it.

impact.definition: How much harm it would do, as last rated. Some documents name a risk without rating it.

mitigation.definition: What is being done about it.

risk_category.definition: The kind of risk, in the firm's words, used to find risks that recur across engagements.
risk_category.label: risk category

finding_area.definition: The area of the client's work this finding concerns.
finding_area.label: area

item_kind.definition: Whether this is an action, something needed from the client, or an issue.
item_kind.label: item kind

effect.definition: What it did to scope, fee and dates, in words.

asset_kind.definition: What sort of asset this is.
asset_kind.label: asset kind

ServiceLine.definition: The kinds of consulting work the firm offers.

cloud-migration.label: Cloud migration
cloud-migration.definition: Moving systems and data to the cloud.

ai-transformation.label: AI transformation
ai-transformation.definition: Changing how an organization works with AI, from assessment to adoption.

data-science.label: Data science
data-science.definition: Models and analysis that answer business questions.

data-engineering.label: Data engineering
data-engineering.definition: Pipelines and platforms that move and prepare data.

RoleKind.definition: What a seat on an engagement is there to do, on either side. The buying roles follow common sales qualification practice.

economic-buyer.label: Economic buyer
economic-buyer.definition: Has the authority and the budget to say yes.

sponsor.label: Sponsor
sponsor.definition: Backs the work at leadership level and answers for it.

champion.label: Champion
champion.definition: Advocates for the work inside the client, with access to the buyer.

day-to-day-lead.label: Day-to-day lead
day-to-day-lead.definition: Runs the work from the client's side.

gatekeeper.label: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.definition: Can block the work, such as procurement, legal or risk.

contact.label: Contact
contact.definition: A named contact for one area, or a source of data.

accountable-executive.label: Accountable executive
accountable-executive.definition: Answers for the commercials and the relationship on the firm's side.

engagement-lead.label: Engagement lead
engagement-lead.definition: Runs the plan and the delivery on the firm's side.

specialist.label: Specialist
specialist.definition: Brings subject expertise on the firm's side.
